conditions.runtime: Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge client with Inventory Tabs 0.10.1-jem.3 and Curios 5.14.1+1.20.1

change.summary: Synchronize Inventory Tabs with third-party container screens that bypass the vanilla init lifecycle

modifiers.before: Set the current container screen only from the injected AbstractContainerScreen.init return hook
modifiers.after: Set and refresh the current container screen at the first tab render or input entry point when screen identity changed

rationale.purpose: Prevent a null current-screen dereference when CuriosScreenV2 is the first supported container screen rendered by Inventory Tabs
rationale.decision_source: User report on 2026-11-19 that the client crashed immediately after receiving the starter-kit backpack
rationale.user_requested: Find and repair the crash that occurred when the starter-kit backpack was received
rationale.implementation_choices: Repair the Inventory Tabs lifecycle owner once for every supported third-party container screen instead of adding a Curios-only injection or hiding the invalid state with a null guard

introduced.summary: Build Inventory Tabs 0.10.1-jem.3 with render and input entry-point screen synchronization

history.summary: Bound the tab manager to the actual supported container screen before tab rendering or input handling

relations: CuriosScreenV2 render -> Inventory Tabs render injection -> current screen synchronization -> safe tab geometry
third-party container screen identity change -> one tab refresh -> native Inventory Tabs rendering
starter-kit backpack reward -> Curios inventory access -> supported container screen
notes: The backpack item, starter-kit reward and Curios inventory data remain unchanged
Inventory Tabs remains client-only and retains its loaded-chunk and single-row pagination patches
The patched production artifact SHA-256 is 08b8b8db8059700d6278b13852c804cfe4f54ff827ed9771bf640cc1a9ea8ecc
MineRENT, the stable JustEnoughMods profile and the immutable release baseline remain unchanged
unresolved: Player acceptance remains pending until Test JustEnoughMods opens the Curios inventory with the patched artifact
